summary: Independent source/integrity review is complete for the persisted 20260913T1300Z cycle and the cycle cannot qualify. Machine identity/tradability and the four machine source probes are healthy, but same-cycle supervisor coverage/discovery are still incomplete. More importantly, the branch is now 109 commits beyond deterministic machine SHA 31800bad and includes material changes to the Earth engine/universe parser/universe membership representation plus a material causal-graph promotion; under the CI/artifact contract those changes invalidate approval of the old machine boundary and require recomputation. A successful later branch-head PR CI does not substitute for exact-SHA execution proof of 31800bad.
